feeds.title: TechCrunch
feeds.description: TechCrunch is a leading technology media platform dedicated to profiling startups, reviewing new internet products, and breaking the latest tech news. Founded in 2005, it has established itself as a vital source of information for the tech industry. TechCrunch is spearheaded by Editor in Chief and General Manager Connie Loizos, who has a deep background in Silicon Valley journalism. The editorial team includes notable contributors like Matt Rosoff, Ingrid Lunden, Frederic Lardinois, and Kirsten Korosec, among others, who bring a wealth of experience and expertise to their respective beats.
